newsitem.title: UK: Future Integrated tumbles, warns of losses.
newsitem.headline: Future Integrated tumbles, warns of losses.

text.p: Shares in Future Integrated Telephony Plc plunged 37 percent on Monday after the company warned it would make a financial loss for the fiscal year to May 31 1997, dealers said.
Future Integrated shares fell 52p to 88-1/2p by 1115 GMT in thin volume.
In a statement, Future said the preliminary results due on August 19 would show a loss not exceeding 600,000 stg for the fiscal year.

The Coventry-based telecommunications company said it had made a loss in the second half although it had originally anticipated in its flotation prospectus published in February 1997 it would make a profit for the period.

Future attributed the losses to a period of expansion in which the number of staff had increased, the company had moved premises and the time from the receipt of orders to installations had lengthened.
However, the company said turnover for the year had reached a record 4.9 million stg.
